title: CADET CLI Build Profile
description: Configuration schema for CADET CLI build and publish operations

profileName.description: Human-readable name for this build profile

os.description: Target operating system(s) for the build

bundleId.description: Bundle identifier for macOS code signing (required when os includes 'mac'). Format: com.company.appname

useGit.description: If true, enables git operations when --git-sync flag is used. Requires gitRepository and gitBranch to be set.

installGitLfsIfMissing.description: If true, CADET runs a Git LFS preflight before git sync. It requires git-lfs to be available and runs 'git lfs install' before clone/fetch.

gitRepository.description: Git repository URL for cloning. Required when useGit is true and --git-sync flag is used.

gitBranch.description: Git branch to checkout and reset to when --git-sync flag is used. Operations: fetch, checkout, hard reset to origin/<branch>, clean untracked files. Runs in unity.projectPath directory. WARNING: Discards all local changes. Requires gitRepository to be set.

editorPath.description: Absolute path to Unity Editor executable

projectPath.description: Absolute path to Unity project directory

buildOutputPath.description: Absolute path to build output directory. Windows builds go to <buildOutputPath>/windows/, macOS builds to <buildOutputPath>/macos/

projectName.description: Unity project name (used as executable name, e.g., <projectName>.exe or <projectName>.app)

engineRoot.description: Absolute path to Unreal Engine root directory

buildOutputPath.description: Absolute path to Unreal build output directory

cookerSettingsOverride.description: Optional path to an .ini file that overrides DefaultEditorPerProjectUserSettings.ini in the synced cooker workspace. Use this to disable auto-start servers (e.g. MCP) that would conflict with the dev editor.

packagingIniOverride.description: Optional path to an .ini file containing +MapsToCook / +DirectoriesToNeverCook entries appended to DefaultGame.ini before cooking. Use for demo/subset builds. Leave empty for full builds.

steam.description: Steam publishing configuration (required if platform is 'steam' or 'both'). Requirements: steamcmdExe required when os is 'windows' or 'both'; steamcmdSh required when os is 'mac' or 'both'

steamcmdExe.description: Path to steamcmd.exe (Windows) - relative to project root or absolute. Typically installed to user directory (e.g., %APPDATA%/CADET/Tools/steamcmd/steamcmd.exe on Windows).

steamcmdSh.description: Path to steamcmd.sh (macOS/Linux) - relative to project root or absolute. Typically installed to user directory (e.g., ~/Library/Application Support/CADET/Tools/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh on macOS).

useSentryFile.description: If true, use sentry file authentication with credentials from ~/.env_mygame_build_steam (automated). If false or omitted, use interactive mode (prompts for password/Steam Guard code). After first successful login with Steam Guard, SteamCMD creates a sentry file for subsequent logins.

description.description: Internal description for this build (shown in SteamCMD output and Steam Partner site). Maps to 'Desc' field in app_build.vdf.

setLive.description: Steam branch to set live after upload. Common values: 'default' (public), 'beta', or custom branch names. Maps to 'SetLive' field in app_build.vdf.

contentRoot.description: Path to content root directory for Steam depot upload. Usually points to the build output directory. Maps to 'ContentRoot' in app_build.vdf.

buildOutput.description: Path to build output directory for SteamCMD logs. Maps to 'BuildOutput' in app_build.vdf.

depots.description: List of Steam depots to upload. Each depot represents a set of files for a specific OS.

depotId.description: Steam Depot ID (from Steamworks partner site)

os.description: Operating system for this depot. Used to filter which depots are included when publishing for a specific OS.

localPath.description: Local path pattern to files relative to contentRoot. Supports wildcards. Use double backslashes for Windows paths in JSON.

depotPath.description: Depot path where files will be placed (root of the depot)

recursive.description: Whether to include subdirectories recursively ('1' = yes, '0' = no)

epic.description: Epic Games Store publishing configuration (required if platform is 'epic' or 'both'). Credentials (CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_SECRET) are loaded from ~/.env_cadet_epic_credentials

productId.description: Epic Product ID (from Epic Developer Portal)

organizationId.description: Epic Organization ID (from Epic Developer Portal)

artifactId.description: Epic Artifact ID (from Epic Developer Portal)

sandboxId.description: Epic Sandbox ID (from Epic Developer Portal)

buildPatchToolPath.description: Path to Epic BuildPatchTool directory - relative to project root or absolute. Typically installed to user directory (e.g., %APPDATA%/CADET/Tools/BuildPatchTool on Windows).

macos.description: macOS-specific configuration. Credentials for signing are loaded from ~/.env_cadet_mac_creds

enableSigning.description: If true and os includes 'mac', run macOS code signing and notarization before publishing. Requires credentials in ~/.env_cadet_mac_creds

entitlementsPath.description: Path to .entitlements file for code signing - relative to project root. Required for proper macOS app signing.

gitBashPath.description: Path to git.exe from Git for Windows installation (Windows only). If not specified, defaults to C:/Program Files/Git/bin/git.exe. Git for Windows provides proper credential manager integration.
